name: Mother's Prayer

notes: A named concept introduced by Plymouth.
Appears to have a connection to Sylan's journal.
Plymouth suggests the journal is known in relation to Mother's Prayer rather than as an isolated document.
Plymouth identified the prophecy previously heard in the Stronghold as the Mother's Prayer or Mother's Prophecy.
The prophecy appears to concern a keeper who will open doors and references the arches and keys.
Plymouth believes the journal discussed by Sylan is connected to this well-known prophecy.
Also referred to as the Mother's Prophecy and Mother's Tale.
A sacred Navi prophecy traditionally used to identify heroes who would aid Atlas.
Described metaphorically as a great tree whose chosen individuals are its fruit.
The associated tales can rewrite themselves depending on the decisions of the chosen individual.
Foretells catastrophic events followed by increasingly difficult choices for the chosen hero.
Includes expectations for the companions who travel alongside the chosen individual.
Exists through numerous independent written accounts created by different authors.
Describes a catastrophic event followed by a chosen hero forced to make increasingly difficult decisions.
The written tales have reportedly rewritten themselves when previous chosen individuals abandoned their path.
Is considered sacred among the Navi and was historically used to identify individuals who would aid them.
Its current chosen hero is believed to be Gerk if he continues accepting the role.
Was unintentionally set into motion when the Navi created the keystones.
Functions as a prophecy that selects individuals when Atlas requires them.
Its purpose is preserving the health and prosperity of all Atlas rather than serving only the Eldarin Tree.
Gerk and his companions are formally accepting responsibility under this prophecy.
Was unintentionally set into motion when the keystones were created.
Acts as a prophecy that periodically selects individuals when Atlas requires them.
Exists for the welfare of all Atlas rather than solely for the Eldarin Tree.
